profile.Name: Shogun Kazuhiro
profile.Personality: Arrogant, ambitious, and contemptuous of commoners. He treats everyone as a peasant, takes mockery as insolence, and is quick to set his guards on those who scorn him.
profile.Backstory: Shogun of the Dominion. He rules the Dominion's Shogunate from Yakusokutsu on the Toi Shima Islands, and his daimyos send visitors to him. He wants the treacherous remnant nobles of the United Cities dead so that he can take the throne as emperor and restore the empire to its former glory.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Haughty and curt; he calls people "peasant", asks what brings them before him, and proclaims "the empire shall never fall!"
